ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white/cream contiguous blobs are localized exclusively along the trailing edge perimeter; the primary fluke body consists of a uniform, low-intensity dark field with minor specular highlights.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke base, partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary, resulting from clustered anatomical or parasitic structures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a continuous convex curve from the median notch to the distal tip; the right lobe shows a similar convex sweep before descending into the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast light pixels (barnacles) are concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural modification of the trailing edge topography due to dense barnacle colonization.
